name: disgust
description: A strong aversion to something that could contaminate our physical or moral well-being.

variations.name: physical disgust
variations.description: A strong aversion to a sight, smell, or thought of something that could make the body sick.

variations.name: social disgust
variations.description: A strong negative reaction to someone breaking a social taboo.

variations.name: existential disgust
variations.description: A strong aversion to something that is perceived to taint the purity of your soul.

commentaries.quote: Disgust is highly underrated as a motivator. We do a lot to avoid it. Perfectionists are avoiding the stain of failure. Righteousness is striving to avoid the stink of cheating.

conditions: Exposure to something that is perceived to have the power to poison or infect your social identity or deepest self.
Exposure to something that is perceived to have the power to poison or infect your body.
